_doc: Organizations to introduce the work to (OUTREACH-INTRO-1). Rows carry only a name, a homepage on the organization's own domain and a segment; scripts/outreach_intro.py resolves a published role mailbox from the organization's own pages and records its source. Never add personal addresses, purchased lists or scraped lists. Add rows with `outreach_intro.py add`; a reply of opt-out, rejected or bounce sets outreach:false.
